In the March 5, 2024 requête before the Conseil de prud'hommes de Beaumont-les-Rives (R.G. n° 24/01984), Claire MOREAU seeks: (1) a finding that the licenciement lacks cause réelle et sérieuse; (2) payment of 14 700,00 € as indemnité for licenciement sans cause réelle et sérieuse (art. L.1235-3); (3) 1 120,00 € bruts as remaining overtime balance plus related congés payés; (4) 3 000,00 € damages for harcèlement moral; (5) 1 500,00 € under article 700 CPC; (6) remittance of end-of-contract documents under an astreinte of 50 € per day of delay after 15 days from judgment notification; and (7) condemnation of SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE to the full costs (dépens)

Through Me FERRAND’s February 15, 2024 letter, Claire MOREAU contests her licenciement as lacking cause réelle et sérieuse and claims it occurred amid managerial pressure amounting to harcèlement moral under article L.1152-1 of the French labour code

In the April 18, 2024 conclusions en défense, SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE states Claire MOREAU was hired on September 15, 2019 and that the employment relationship proceeded without major incident until the end of 2023, with difficulties appearing in the fourth quarter of 2023 before the January 28, 2024 licenciement pour cause réelle et sérieuse

Following the January 12, 2024 entretien préalable at which Claire MOREAU presented her observations assisted by M. Karim BENALI, SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE dismissed her for: repeated lateness on December 3, 7 and 14, 2023 despite an oral reminder on December 5, 2023; inappropriate behavior toward client LUMO SA on December 19, 2023 harming the company’s image; and characterized professional insufficiency on ligne B in Q4 2023 measured by internal intervention-time indicators

On January 28, 2024, SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE sent Claire MOREAU at 14, rue des Lilas, 45000 Orléans-sur-Clain a registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt (N° AR 2C 123 987 654 0, réf. RH/2024/LIC-007) notifying her licenciement pour cause réelle et sérieuse, signed by Président Julien CARRÉ

On January 2, 2024, SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE sent Claire MOREAU at 14, rue des Lilas, 45000 Orléans-sur-Clain a registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt (N° de suivi AR 2C 098 765 432 1, réf. RH/2024/EP-003) for a convocation to an entretien préalable à un éventuel licenciement pour cause réelle et sérieuse, signed by Président Julien CARRÉ

Claire MOREAU was summoned by SAS ATELIER RIVIÈRE to an entretien préalable on Friday January 12, 2024 at 10:00 in the bureau de la direction at 8, quai des Forges, 45000 Orléans-sur-Clain, where the company would present the grounds for the contemplated dismissal and collect her explanations

Under article L.1234-1 of the French labour code and the applicable collective agreement, Claire MOREAU’s préavis after the January 28, 2024 dismissal notification is two months, starting from the date of first presentation of the letter; she is dispensed from executing it and will receive an indemnité compensatrice de préavis with the solde de tout compte
